bio: Giovanna Iera, also called Joanna, was born in May 1658 at San Mango di Aquino, Catanzaro, Calabria, Italy. She married Antonio Colosimo there on 11 February 1680. She died at San Mango di Aquino and was buried on 8 January 1707. She was John's 9th-great-grandmother.
